Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85622083634
Zoom Meeting ID: 856 2208 3634
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 856 2208 3634#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.

I NCORPORATED 1939

  MINUTES
  OF THE DECEMBER 22, 2020 SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTA TES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant
to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called
to order by Mayor Kemps at 6:31 P.M. on December 22, 2020, notice having been given with
affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information
to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85622083634
  Zoom Meeting ID: 856 2208 3634

  BY TELEPHONE: 1669900 9128, Enter Code: 856 2208 3634#

BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-42

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 020-748

CALL TO ORDER 6:31 P.M.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
  Murdock

ALSO PRESENT:
  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Acting Police Chief Best, Acting
  Planning & Building Director Rindge, Finance Director Hannah, City Clerk
  Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember
  Roos to approve the agenda. The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Mayor Kemps noted the upcoming Palos Verdes Homes Association annual meeting. He thanked
photographer Erik Jay for his donation, and reported on the Holiday Parade and thanked
everyone involved.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 22 , 2020
 CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 -3)

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, Seconded by Councilmember
  Roos to approve the consent agenda with the addition of Item #7. The motion
  carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos , McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

1.  City Council Action Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved:
  a.  December 8, 2020 Regular Meeting Minutes

2.  Approval of Warrant Registers

  Reviewed and Approved Warrant Registers: 12222020-A, 12222020-B, 12222020-
  C, 12112020-A.

3.  Planning Commission Actions of November 17, 2020

  Received and Filed.

7.  Adoption of Resolution No. R20-42 Setting the Frequency, Time, and Place of the
  Regular Meetings of the Finance Advisory Committee (to Once Each Month on
  the Third Wednesday at 6:00 PM in the City Council Chambers) Effective
  January 20, 2021
  Adopted proposed Resolution No. R20-42 setting the frequency, time, and place of
  the Regular Meetings of the Finance Advisory Committee (FAC) to once each month
  on the third Wednesday at 6:00 PM in the City Council Chambers.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

PUBLIC HEARING(S)

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

4. Planning Commission Actions of December 15, 2020

  Acting Planning and Building Director Rindge reported.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Lozzi, Seconded by Councilmember Roo s to
  receive and file the Planning Commission actions of December 15 , 2020. The motion
  carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN:  McGowan

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 22 , 2020
 5. Participation in the Peninsula Public Safety Committee, Replacing the Peninsula
  Emergency Preparedness Committee

  Acting Chief Best reported.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember Roos to
  Notify the Regional Law Enforcement Committee of the City' s desire to participate in the
  Peninsula Public Safety Committee and Update the City Council' s Committee and Liaison
  assignments to replace the Peninsula Emergency Preparedness Committee with the Peninsula
  Public Safety Committee upon final action of the Regional Law Enforcement Committee.

  The motion carried by the following roll call vote :

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos , McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

6. Ratify City Council Committee and Liaison Assignments as Presented by the Mayor;
  Consider the Creation of a New City Council Liaison Assignment to the Palos Verdes
  Homes Association; Discuss and Articulate the Goals of Various Ad Hoc Committees
  of the City Council; and Dissolve the Palos Verdes Estates Foundation Ad Hoc
  Committee

  The following individuals addressed the City Council: Joan Davidson, Desiree Myers

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, Seconded by Councilmember McGowan to
  ratify the Committee and Liaison assignments with edits, including the addition of the
  Liaison to the Palos Verdes Homes Association and removing the Revenue Evaluation Ad
  Hoc Committee, and formally dissolving the Palos Verdes Foundation Ad Hoc Committee.

  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

7. Moved to Consent Agenda

STAFF REPORTS

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  L  City Manager's Report
  City Manager Guglielmo reported, recognizing the years of service award recipients
  and this year's Neptune Award recipient, Sergeant Erick Gaunt.

  a. State of the Police Department - Oral Report
  Acting Chief Best reported on the newly elected Los Angeles County District Attorney
  directives, and the Police Department's commitment to keep Palos Verdes Estates safe
  and secure.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

Mayor Kemps reviewed City Council operating guidelines, noting an update in the process for
future agenda items requested by Councilmembers.

Councilmember Roos shared his concerns regarding the pandemic and wished everyone happy
holidays.

Councilmember Murdock thanked staff. She requested future agenda items for a review of Minor
Mod code changes, goal setting and latest financial projections.

Councilmember McGowan thanked staff and wished everyone happy holidays.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 22 , 2020
 Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi thanked staff, the residents and Council, and wished everyone happy
holidays.
Mayor Kemps requested a future agenda item for a discussion of the technology and practical
requirements for a hybrid return to use of the Council chambers. He also wished everyone happy
holidays and expressed his appreciation of the holiday parade and noted he hopes that it can
continue in the future.

ADJOURNMENT
  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember Roos
  to adjourn the meeting at 9:36 p.m.

  AYES:  Roos, Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor
